flipToBack.prose: Flip if Xizor (or legacy Shada under LEGACY__TREAT_XIZOR_AS_SHADA) is at a battleground site AND Luke (or Rey/Anakin under Reflections-II retarget mods) is NOT at a battleground site.

children.req: can-spot: Xizor at a battleground site
can-spot: Luke-target at a battleground site
children.filter: Filters.and(lukeFilter, Filters.at(Filters.battleground_site)); lukeFilter = TARGETS_REY_INSTEAD_OF_LUKE ? Filters.Rey : TARGETS_ANAKIN_INSTEAD_OF_LUKE ? Filters.Anakin : Filters.Luke

flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front if the Luke-target (Luke, or Rey/Anakin under retarget mods) is at a battleground site, OR Xizor (or legacy Shada) is not on table.

children.req: can-spot: Luke-target at a battleground site
children.filter: Filters.and(lukeFilter, Filters.at(Filters.battleground_site)); lukeFilter = Rey|Anakin|Luke per Reflections-II retarget mods

requirementSemantics: Both flip legs are can-spot AT checks (Filters.at(Filters.battleground_site)), not control or occupy; SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE on every spot.
Front flip has a positive leaf (Xizor at bg site) AND a negative leaf (Luke-target NOT at bg site).
Back flip is a disjunction: Luke-target at bg site OR Xizor missing from table (card-on-table check).

Retarget chosen-states: ModifyGameTextType.REFLECTIONS_II_OBJECTIVE__TARGETS_REY_INSTEAD_OF_LUKE -> Filters.Rey; ...TARGETS_ANAKIN_INSTEAD_OF_LUKE -> Filters.Anakin; LEGACY__TREAT_XIZOR_AS_SHADA -> Filters.title("Shada").
typedIdentities: Filters.Xizor (persona); Filters.title("Shada") legacy alternate; Filters.Luke / Filters.Rey / Filters.Anakin (personas)

Black Sun agents: Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.or(Filters.and(Filters.alien, Filters.loreContains("Black Sun")), Filters.bounty_hunter, Filters.information_broker)) -> Keyword.BLACK_SUN_AGENT
Deploy lock exception set: Filters.or(Filters.Black_Sun_agent, yourBlackSunAgents, Filters.Emperor, Filters.and(Icon.INDEPENDENT, Filters.starship))
setupAndPullRoutes: Setup (required on objective deploy): deploy Imperial City (Filters.Imperial_City) (Card10_029.java:68-74); deploy Xizor to Imperial City (Filters.Xizor -> Filters.Imperial_City) (:101-107); deploy Coruscant system (Filters.Coruscant_system) (:109-115).
Legacy branch: if reserve holds [LEGACY_BLOCK_4] No Bargain AND [LEGACY_BLOCK_4] Shada, may deploy Shada instead of Xizor and then also deploy No Bargain (V) (Card10_029.java:76-99).

No repeatable download on either side; the only ongoing special move is the bounty-hunter regular move (both sides): during your control phase each of your bounty hunters at a site may make a regular move to an adjacent site where there is a bounty (Filters.movableAsRegularMove(...Filters.and(Filters.adjacentSite(bh), Filters.sameSiteAs(self, Filters.any_bounty)))) (Card10_029.java:120-155; Card10_029_BACK.java:66-97).
otherObligations: Both sides deploy lock: you may not deploy cards with ability (or permanent pilots with ability) except Black Sun agents, Emperor, or [Independent] starships (Card10_029.java:59-60; Card10_029_BACK.java:179).

Both sides: your Black-Sun-lore aliens, bounty hunters, and information brokers gain Keyword.BLACK_SUN_AGENT (Card10_029.java:56-58; BACK:175-178); Scanning Crew may not be played (front bans BOTH players: MayNotPlayModifier without player arg, Card10_029.java:61; back same :180).
Back: attrition against opponent +1 per Black Sun agent in battle (AttritionModifier + InBattleEvaluator) (Card10_029_BACK.java:181).
Back: once per turn place a card from hand on Used Pile to peek at your Force Pile (Card10_029_BACK.java:102-118).
Back: once during your battle phase, peek at top X cards of any Reserve Deck, X = locations you occupy (Card10_029_BACK.java:123-147).

Back Force-loss engine: once during your control phase opponent loses 1 Force per battleground OCCUPIED-WITH Xizor or Emperor (Filters.occupiesWith(playerId, self, Filters.or(xizorFilter, Filters.Emperor))); offered as top-level action (:153-167) and auto-fires as required trigger at end of your control phase if unused (:196-211).
Strategic: keep Xizor on table and at a battleground site, and keep Luke-target off battleground sites, or the back flips to front.
seedMismatches: Seed flipRequirements say the retargeted Luke alternatives are 'Luke/Leia/Kanan/Anakin'; source Card10_029.java:167-169 uses ModifyGameTextType.REFLECTIONS_II_OBJECTIVE__TARGETS_REY_INSTEAD_OF_LUKE -> Filters.Rey and ...TARGETS_ANAKIN_INSTEAD_OF_LUKE -> Filters.Anakin. Alternatives are Rey and Anakin, never Leia or Kanan.
Seed flipBackRequirements repeat the same wrong list ('retargeted Luke/Leia/Kanan/Anakin'); source Card10_029_BACK.java:216-218 is Rey | Anakin | Luke.
